gumroad_listing.description:
State-licensed HVAC contractors across Texas, California, and Florida — 140,000+ records sourced from official state contractor licensing boards. The same data commercial vendors charge $2,000–$5,000/year for — available as a one-time $79 download.

**What's included:**
- Business name and owner/licensee name
- License number and license type (HVAC-R, Mechanical, Air Conditioning, Refrigeration)
- License status: Active or Inactive
- Business address: street, city, state, ZIP
- Phone number (where publicly available)
- Original license issue date
- License expiration date
- State licensing board source URL for every row

**Coverage:**
- Texas: ~45,000 HVAC/mechanical contractors (TDLR)
- California: ~62,000 C-20 HVAC contractors (CSLB)
- Florida: ~33,000 HVAC/mechanical contractors (DBPR)
- Combined: 140,000+ total records, 100,000+ active licenses

**Bonus filters:**
- License classification (HVAC-R vs. Mechanical vs. Air Conditioning vs. Refrigeration) for specialty targeting
- Active/Inactive status — isolate operating contractors instantly
- Years-in-business (derived from issue date) — segment new licensees vs. established firms
- Expiration dates — target upcoming renewals for CE training or insurance renewal campaigns

**Who buys this:**
- HVAC equipment manufacturers (Carrier, Trane, Lennox) building dealer networks by state and territory
- Field service software vendors (ServiceTitan, Jobber, Housecall Pro, FieldEdge) running contractor acquisition campaigns
- HVAC insurance brokers writing GL/WC policies to licensed contractors
- Wholesale HVAC supply distributors targeting new contractor accounts

**Why $79 one-time beats $2,000+ subscriptions:**

You don't need a subscription. You need Texas, California, and Florida — the three largest HVAC markets in the US. Here they are. One payment. No recurring fees.
